records.source: That was outstanding! I'm really glad that you brought me out for this, @.$h
records.translation: Pambihira iyon! Tuwang-tuwa akong isinama mo ako rito, @.$h

records.source: I don't watch a lot of movies, but this one's been well-received, right?
records.translation: Hindi ako madalas manood ng pelikula, pero maganda raw ang pagtanggap dito, hindi ba?

records.source: That was interesting! I'm going to be thinking about {0} one for a while.
records.translation: Kawili-wili iyon! Matagal ko pang pag-iisipan ang pelikulang '{0}'.

records.source: This movie seems a little intense for me...$s
records.translation: Mukhang medyo matindi para sa akin ang pelikulang ito...$s

records.source: I feel faint...$8
records.translation: Parang mahihimatay ako...$8

records.source: Harvey's blood pressure is skyrocketing!
records.translation: Mabilis na tumataas ang presyon ng dugo ni Harvey!

records.source: My body feels inflamed after that movie...$s
records.translation: Parang namamaga ang katawan ko matapos ang pelikulang iyon...$s

records.source: I saw a commercial for this on the TV. It looks really funny!
records.translation: Nakita ko ang patalastas nito sa telebisyon. Mukhang nakakatawa talaga!

records.source: As an amateur connoisseur, the weird obsession with gluten-based food was hilarious.$h
records.translation: Bilang baguhang dalubhasa sa pagkain, nakatatawa ang kakaiba nilang pagkahumaling sa pagkaing gawa sa gluten.$h

records.source: It doesn't feel like the holidays until you've seen '{0}'!
records.translation: Hindi ko madarama ang kapaskuhan hangga't hindi ko napapanood ang '{0}'!

records.source: That was heartwarming... and somehow they make that fabled fruit seem so delicious. I'd love to taste it one day.
records.translation: Nakapagpapainit ng puso iyon... at kahit paano ay ginawa nilang napakasarap tingnan ang maalamat na prutas na iyon. Gusto ko iyong matikman balang araw.

records.source: They say this movie is 'unconventional'... does that mean it's bad?$s
records.translation: Sabi nila ay 'di-karaniwan' ang pelikulang ito... ibig bang sabihin niyon ay masama ito?$s

records.source: What was the point of that one? I don't get it. Maybe I'm too old.$s
records.translation: Ano ba ang punto niyon? Hindi ko maintindihan. Baka masyado na akong matanda.$s

records.source: *sniff* *sniff* ... I smell something delicious...
records.translation: *singhot* *singhot* ... May naaamoy akong masarap...

records.source: Not bad at all. I'm really glad I came!
records.translation: Hindi talaga masama. Mabuti na lang at sumama ako!

records.source: I watched cowboy movies when I was a kid... I'm glad to see the art is still alive!
records.translation: Nanood ako ng mga pelikulang koboy noong bata ako... Natutuwa akong buhay pa rin ang sining na iyon!

records.source: (I wonder what kind of moustache wax he uses?)
records.translation: (Ano kayang uri ng pomada sa bigote ang ginagamit niya?)

records.source: Mayor Lewis seems deep in thought...
records.translation: Tila malalim ang iniisip ni Alkalde Lewis...

records.source: Heh, that was great! Really brought me back...$h
records.translation: Heh, napakaganda niyon! Talagang nagbalik ang mga alaala ko...$h

records.source: The governor himself recommended this movie to me!
records.translation: Mismong Gobernador ang nagrekomenda sa akin ng pelikulang ito!

records.source: Fantastic! They really made Stardew Valley look beautiful, didn't they? If only they had featured Pelican Town itself...$h
records.translation: Napakahusay! Talagang napaganda nila ang Stardew Valley, hindi ba? Kung itinampok lamang sana nila ang mismong Bayan ng Pelican...$h

records.source: As mayor, I need to know what kinds of movies are being shown in our community. We have the tender minds of the next generation to worry about!
records.translation: Bilang alkalde, kailangan kong malaman kung anong uri ng mga pelikula ang ipinapalabas sa ating komunidad. Dapat nating pangalagaan ang murang isipan ng susunod na salinlahi!

records.source: Hah! That wasn't bad at all... I'd say this one's 'Mayor Approved'.$h
records.translation: Hah! Hindi talaga iyon masama... Masasabi kong 'Aprubado ng Alkalde' ito.$h

records.source: Hmm... I guess it will be interesting to see what the young people are watching these days...
records.translation: Hmm... Sa palagay ko ay magiging kawili-wiling malaman kung ano ang pinanonood ng mga kabataan ngayon...

records.source: Huh... I wonder if the messages in this movie are good for our community?
records.translation: Huh... Ang mga mensahe kaya sa pelikulang ito ay mabuti para sa ating komunidad?

records.source: I saw this movie once, a long time ago. It's very romantic!
records.translation: Matagal ko nang napanood ang pelikulang ito. Napakaromantiko nito!

records.source: That was lovely... The theme of the movie really resonated with me. Thanks for bringing me!
records.translation: Napakaganda niyon... Talagang tumimo sa akin ang tema ng pelikula. Salamat sa pagsama sa akin!

records.source: I hope the seats are plush, I've been on my feet all day!
records.translation: Sana ay malalambot ang mga upuan. Maghapon akong nakatayo!

records.source: I'm not much of a movie buff... but I had a good time! Thanks, @.
records.translation: Hindi ako gaanong mahilig sa pelikula... pero nasiyahan ako! Salamat, @.

records.source: Oh man, I'm so excited for this! I heard it has a great soundtrack.
records.translation: Naku, sabik na sabik ako rito! Nabalitaan kong napakaganda ng musika nito.
